data.title: Iran names new defense minister after predecessor killed during war with Israel | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Akhlachi replaces Majid Ebn al-Reza, who took over in an interim capacity after then Defense Minister Aziz Nasirzadeh was killed by US-Israeli strikes in February.
